title: Filter panel
description: Filters on phones: one segmented pill (the page's views · Bộ lọc with the count · sort and view settings) that opens a full-screen panel: sort first, booleans as switches, one accordion per filter, “Xem N kết quả” at the bottom. From sm the panel is a side sheet, also the “Bộ lọc” panel of a page with more filters than its chip row shows.
when: Below md on every page that has a FilterChipRow on desktop (same filters, same state).
A desktop page whose filters do not fit in chips (many facets, a date range): a Bộ lọc button opens the panel as a side sheet.

instead.need: A form in a sheet (edit a record)

a11y: The panel is a modal dialog named “Bộ lọc”: focus moves in, Tab stays inside, Escape closes and focus returns to the button that opened it.
The Bộ lọc button's name is its text and the count (“Bộ lọc 2”); it has aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded (filtersOpen).
Each accordion is a heading with a button (aria-expanded, aria-controls); the sort is a group of toggle buttons (aria-pressed).
notes: Changes apply at once (the list behind updates); “Xem N kết quả” only closes. Keep the open state in the URL (?filters=1) when Back should close it.
The accordions of filters that are on start open (at most two).
Phone chrome stays within 2 rows (P1): the search, then this bar; the result line may follow.
